# Youngbloods
## Youngblood handler and responsibilities The hunter who calls the ERT is in charge of the youngbloods regardless of rank, and is held responsible for their actions.
Youngbloods may only be taken to the hunting preserve and the Yautja ship. However, if the threat side initiates hijack, you may bring youngbloods down to the main map. This does not include INSFOR hijacks, or hijacks between GOVFOR and OPFOR in Force on Force.
## Youngblood kill button The youngblood kill button is not to be used unless a serious Honor Code break is witnessed or the player is being LRP. It is a last resort. The button logs the reason and both parties' C-keys, and you may face repercussions for using it.
## Youngblood expectations Youngblood is not a role for learning the Honor Code down to its smallest details. As long as the youngblood is not breaking the Honor Code or being LRP, not knowing all of it is fine. The role is meant to let players experience a different roleplay environment outside the main game loop.
